title: 3D Character Configurator
description: An interactive 3D character configurator built with React Three Fiber. Users can adjust character attributes, swap components, and preview changes in real time.

title: 3D Molecule Maker
description: A browser-based 3D molecule maker and viewer built with React Three Fiber and GLTF models for interactive molecular visualization.

title: 3D Prototype Cube
description: A small React Three Fiber prototype used to explore interactive 3D behavior, parameter-driven meshes, lighting, and animation.

title: CodePen spinning circle Image Revealer
description: An image-reveal experiment using SVG masks and JavaScript animation to create a circular transition. Hovering changes the animation speed and circle size.

title: USU Aerospace Wingcraft Web Application
description: An interactive 3D airplane-wing modeling application for USU Aerospace. Users can adjust wing parameters and preview animated flight paths; Blender models and backend data sharing support the experience.

title: 3D Maze Ball Configurator
description: A web-based 3D maze-ball configurator built with React Three Fiber and GLTF, allowing users to explore and customize maze layouts.

title: Drug Screening Analysis Program
description: A Python analysis tool for multiplex high-throughput drug-screening data from flow cytometry. The resume reports saving 200+ hours of manual work and about $1,500 in labor costs; the project is associated with a peer-reviewed study.

title: Paleobiological GIS Program
description: An educational GIS application that maps fossil sites across geologic time using data from the Paleobiology Database.

title: Personal Learning System
description: A personal learning and productivity tool for organizing objectives, tasks, and files, built with Next.js.
